description: Preflight check before cloning or embedding a URL, without launching a browser. Returns whether the page can be reused/embedded as-is, needs local browser capture, needs a logged-in session, needs manual review, or should be blocked, plus the next tool to call.

exact_requested.description: True (default) when the user wants an exact, faithful clone; false when an approximate rebuild is acceptable.

license_text.description: License or permission text that allows reusing the page, from the user or the site; informs the reuse/rebuild policy.

source_signals.description: Extra hints about the page's origin, e.g. ["framer", "spline", "export"]; merged with signals detected from the page.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the static HTTP fetch of the page.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to inspect, capture, or clone.

name: audit_reference_url
